title: Visitors' base under the mountains at Dulce

tellings.quote: Somebody told me long ago about that very thing that that these visitors already had a place picked out where they wanted to reside

plain: Visitors from elsewhere had already picked out a place to live under the mountains at Dulce, a town in New Mexico. Mario Woods, an Air Force veteran who says he was abducted by aliens, tells it as something that somebody told him long ago. If true, it would mean these visitors keep a home base here on Earth.
